'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against infrastructure]]
***[[29 December 2023 Russian strikes on Ukraine]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] launches the largest wave of [[drone warfare|drones]] and [[missile]]s on [[Ukrainian cities]] since the start of the war in a widespread overnight assault across the country, killing at least 39 people and injuring at least 160 others. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-aerial-attack-missiles-drones-fe3fb596cdea0035573a6a677f17070c (AP)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2023/12/29/7435141/ (Ukrainian Pravda)]
****One of the [[Russia]]n [[cruise missile]]s enters [[NATO]] airspace as it travels over [[Poland|Polish]] territory, prompting the [[Politics of Poland|Polish government]] to summon the Russian [[charge d'affaires]] for an explanation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/unidentified-object-entered-poland-direction-ukraine-says-polish-army-2023-12-29/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-12-29/poland-says-unidentified-airborne-object-entered-from-ukraine (Bloomberg)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Six people are killed and 26 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a party in [[Ciudad Obregón]], [[Sonora]], [[Mexico]]. The shooting's target, a [[drug cartel|cartel]] member, is among those killed. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-6-killed-cartel-killings-sonora-1efa27100f3e190633064d78004ce7c8 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**At least 20 people are killed by [[landslide]]s caused by torrential rains in [[Mwenga Territory|Mwenga]], [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-landslides-rains-floods-deaths-82c892e9d99ac2590d48fdcc473aec07 (AP)]
*Around 120 people are rescued from a breakaway [[ice floe]] on [[Red Lake (Minnesota)|Upper Red Lake]] near [[Bemidji, Minnesota]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/12/29/us/minnesota-ice-rescue-122-people/index.html (CNN)]
